info.title: API.SH: Packagist
info.description: The Packagist API from API.SH: public Packagist data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Usage per day and per endpoint
get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: ok, error, or an HTTP status like 502.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: Route prefix, e.g. /tiktok/v1

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: ISO time.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Cursor from `next`.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
Security advisories for one or more packages, or all advisories updated since a date: advisory id, package, title, CVE, severity, affected versions, report date, link and sources.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-advisories

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: One or more packages, comma-separated (vendor/package).

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: Advisories updated since this date (YYYY-MM-DD; within 31 days when no name is given).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

advisories.title: Inline Fragments Let Untrusted Forwarded Headers Set the Host, Scheme and Port of the URLs Generated for the Main Request
CVE-2026-45075: HEAD Request Bypasses methods: ['GET'] Filter in #[IsGranted] / #[IsSignatureValid] / #[IsCsrfTokenValid]

get.description:
Packages that require a package, most installed first (at most 5 pages) or the whole list in Packagist's order: name, description, type, the version constraint, installs, favers and abandoned state. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-dependents

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package as vendor/package (monolog/monolog), a `composer require` command or a packagist.org link.

parameters.name: order_by
parameters.description: downloads (default, at most 5 pages) or none (the whole list).

parameters.name: requires
parameters.description: all (default), require or require-dev.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

dependents.description: Guzzle is a PHP HTTP client library

get.description:
Install statistics of a package or one version as a daily, weekly or monthly series between two dates, plus the package's total, monthly and daily installs.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-downloads

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package as vendor/package (monolog/monolog), a `composer require` command or a packagist.org link.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: One version, e.g. 3.12.0 (default: all versions).

parameters.name: average
parameters.description: daily, weekly or monthly (default).

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The latest releases on Packagist (`type=releases`), newly added packages (`type=new`), or the latest releases of one vendor or one package: package, version, description, date, link and author.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-feed

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: releases (default) or new.

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Only this vendor's releases.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Only this package's releases (vendor/package).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

parameters.name: username

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The most installed packages on Packagist, with installs and favers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-popular

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Packages per page, 1-100 (default 15).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Searches Packagist, the PHP Composer registry, by words, package type (library, symfony-bundle, wordpress-plugin, project and others) and tags: name, description, repository, installs and favers. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words (optional when type or tags is given).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Composer package type, e.g. library, symfony-bundle, laravel-package, wordpress-plugin.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated tags (keywords), e.g. psr-3,logging.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Results per page, 1-100 (default 15).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every package a vendor publishes (optionally of one type), with type, repository and abandoned state. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-vendor

parameters.name: vendor
parameters.description: Vendor name, e.g. symfony.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Only this package type, e.g. symfony-bundle.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Packages per page, 1-1000 (default 200).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Every tagged version of a package (or its development branches with `dev=true`), newest first, each with release date, license, authors, homepage, require, require-dev, suggest, provide, replace and conflict lists, source and dist, plus the package's security advisories. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/packagist-versions

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Package as vendor/package (monolog/monolog), a `composer require` command or a packagist.org link.

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Only this version, e.g. 3.12.0.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: true for development branches (dev-main etc.), false (default) for tagged releases.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Versions per page, 1-500 (default 50).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
